scope.geometry: Each arm uses the same whole-image embedding items and atomic, full-block visual-prefix checkpoints. Each request's checkpoint ends at the last whole 128-row block at or before the image-closing marker. Prefix hits preserve at least one final prompt row for logits. All items use identical content and positional key support.
scope.policy: Fixed LRU partitions compare with frequency-cost-per-byte unified GreedyDual. The scope policy uses the same score and appends a factor of up to 2x for embeddings observed in multiple exact prefix scopes. Insertion and weights depend only on history. Event order is sequential complete-before-next.
scope.timing: When available, isolated CUDA-event calibration is interpolated by query rows or contiguous transfer bytes and linearly scaled outside its support. Copy and compute estimates remain separate additive stages. The maximum of aggregate E/P compute demands is a service-floor proxy with ideal overlap. This replay does not represent per-request delay, actual bottleneck, decode, contention, or goodput.
scope.encode: The encode-bypass sensitivity checks both connector contracts. In the bypass mode an image is skipped only when its entire span is covered by the exact checkpoint. A prefix hit and embedding hit never book overlapping encode cost.
